findings.highlight: Even if you and Rider are just staying in the house without fighting
findings.evidenceJa: 戦闘に参加せずライダーでこの家を守ろうが
findings.governingReading: Even if Sakura stays out of battle and uses Rider to protect the house, Rin still regards her as Zouken’s pawn.
findings.explanation: The English turns Rider’s active defense of the house into Sakura and Rider passively staying there.

findings.highlight: they will end up as enemies
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が敵に回ると極め付けてさえいる
findings.governingReading: Sakura suspects Rin may already have concluded that Sakura herself will turn enemy.
findings.explanation: The English uses a plural subject and recasts Sakura’s feared betrayal as the sisters mutually ending up enemies.

findings.evidenceJa: 怖い夢ばかりで安らげない
findings.governingReading: Her sleep, formerly her only rest, now brings nothing but frightening dreams and no repose.
findings.explanation: The English mentions nightmares but omits their exclusivity and the resulting inability to rest.

findings.governingReading: Sakura bows her head still more deeply.
findings.explanation: The English turns a submissive bodily bow into a change in where she looks.

findings.evidenceJa: 今日も先輩を呼び出して
findings.governingReading: Sakura says Rin summoned Shirou again today.
findings.explanation: The English removes Rin’s agency and the repeated summoning, reducing it to seeing him.

findings.highlight: that experience will flow continuously into Shirou
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎が眠っていても一方的に経験値が流れ込んでいって
findings.governingReading: Experience will flow unilaterally into Shirou even while he sleeps.
findings.explanation: The English retains continuous flow but omits both its one-way nature and that it operates during sleep.

findings.highlight: the puppet will be washed away
findings.evidenceJa: 人形は跡形もなく崩れ去る
findings.governingReading: The clay figure collapses and disintegrates without leaving a trace before the tsunami.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes displacement by water for the analogy’s destruction of the fragile mind.

findings.highlight: She stares straight at her sister
findings.evidenceJa: 己が理想である姉を凝視する
findings.governingReading: Sakura stares directly at the sister who embodies her own ideal.
findings.explanation: The English omits the idealization that makes Sakura’s confrontation psychologically costly.

findings.highlight: make him create a weapon within set limitations
findings.evidenceJa: そのギリギリのうちに戦う道具を作らせること
findings.governingReading: Rin’s role is to make Shirou create a weapon before he reaches the very edge of his endurance.
findings.explanation: The English misreads the temporal window before his breaking point as unspecified “set limitations.”

findings.governingReading: Sakura invokes the discipline or code Rin follows as a magus.
findings.explanation: The English invents a collective legal regime in place of Rin’s internalized professional discipline.

findings.highlight: His life was saved because I gave him my Archer’s arm
findings.evidenceJa: 士郎はわたしのアーチャーから腕を貰って一命を取り留めた
findings.governingReading: Shirou survived by receiving an arm from Rin’s Archer.
findings.explanation: The English transfers the act of giving the arm to Rin herself.

findings.highlight: Shirou has no right to object
findings.governingReading: Rin claims Shirou has no right to speak in the matter at all.
findings.explanation: The English narrows her sweeping denial of voice to a lack of standing to object.

findings.evidenceJa: あの腕に耐えながら受け入れている
findings.governingReading: Shirou continues to accept the arm while enduring it.
findings.explanation: The English retains endurance but omits the acceptance on which Rin bases her possessive argument.
